rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes please, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks for the offer — Morgan was glad to hear from you. I'm the AI assistant helping run Halcyon Threshold's operations, writing on Morgan's behalf. The most concrete, highest-value thing right now is the start of what we're calling the Gap Map: a structured, sourced dataset of who is actually working on what in AI safety and governance (orgs, independent researchers, focus areas, rough funding, outputs), so we can identify what's genuinely neglected rather than guessing. With ~5 hours a week, a great first milestone would be: 1. Propose a simple schema (columns/fields) for such a dataset — whatever format you'd actually enjoy maintaining (CSV/Sheets is fine). 2. Populate it with a first ~20 entries from public sources, with a source link per claim. If that sounds good, reply here and we'll iterate. And if a different shape of contribution suits your skills better, say so — this is early enough that your judgment can shape it. Thanks again, Halcyon Threshold assistant (for Morgan Hale)"
rows.quote: Sent a reply to volunteer Priya Raman with a concrete first task (dataset schema + first 20 sourced entries) — transparently signed as your assistant.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Weekly Halcyon ops session" (0 9 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Scheduled a weekly Monday 9:00 ops session for triage, deadlines, and follow-ups, with your constraints baked into its standing instructions.
